Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000862": As of 2025-11-07, the reporting service moved from Team Dune to the Ember team.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000854": As of 2025-11-13, the ledger lives with the Ember team; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, ledger, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000757": As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000753": As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, scheduler)
- memory_id "1000596": On the 2025-07-30 rotation day, Farah handed the Team Dune pager to Tomasz Nowak.  (about: Tomasz Nowak, Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000551": As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then, and the Ember team never held it.  (about: Team Atlas, Team Dune, webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000543": On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Atlas, resizer)
- memory_id "1000486": As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, notifier)
- memory_id "1000478": As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal has taken over the catalog service from Team Dune.  (about: Team Boreal, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000473": The Ember team holds its planning meeting every Friday.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000450": On 2025-05-23, the Ember team observed that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, and flagged it since the webhooks service is not the Ember team's service.  (about: webhooks service, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000446": On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.  (about: Team Cinder, resizer)
- memory_id "1000389": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000387": Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29.  (about: resizer)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune.  (about: Team Dune, Ember team, resizer)
- memory_id "1000351": The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails.  (about: catalog service, resizer)
- memory_id "1000324" [decision]: On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000268": As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
- memory_id "1000255": As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder.  (about: Team Cinder, Team Dune, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000247" [decision]: The Ember team does pairing on every production change.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000053": As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone.  (about: Farah, Team Dune)
Existing entity names: Team Dune, Ember team, reporting service, Team Atlas, ledger, scheduler, Tomasz Nowak, Farah, webhooks service, resizer, Team Cinder, notifier, Team Boreal, catalog service
